limitations: This is a style-approval prototype, not a surveyed map or a validated navigational base.

Generative interpretation simplifies and alters individual buildings, facades, small details, street widths and local scale despite the OSM reference. Exact footprint and bridge alignment are not certified.
The final production map must use the coordinator supplied white geometry base or a deterministic OSM base to lock geometry before seamless tiles are approved.
Output is native 1572 x 1001 pixels, no upscaling; no resolution requirement was specified in the source.
